title: F05: Receipt pipeline: upload, background extraction, persist, failure handling
milestone: M3 Extraction pipeline
labels: backend, ai
---
## Goal
Upload a receipt, extract it in the background, persist the result and handle every failure path.

**Depends on:** F03, F04
**Built by:** `backend-dev`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Every row of the failure-handling table in `backend/ai-extraction.md` has an API test
- [ ] Status polling follows `contracts/receipt-lifecycle.md`
- [ ] `merchant` is stored after `domain.redaction.clean_merchant`, and line-item descriptions and `raw_model_output` after `redact_text` (decision 0017), with tests; raw output is never logged
- [ ] Decide whether the stored raw output gets its `merchant` replaced by the `clean_merchant` result (0017, known gap)

## Read first
- `docs/wiki/backend/ai-extraction.md`, `persistence.md`
- `docs/wiki/contracts/receipt-lifecycle.md`, `api-endpoints.md`, `error-format.md`
